gaps.issue: Wall clock adjustments can increase/decrease remaining time
gaps.mitigation: Active monotonic elapsed plus persisted max-observed elapsed and warning; offline trusted clock impossible

gaps.issue: Interval-based timeout can be late after tab suspension and actions lack deadline enforcement
gaps.mitigation: Deadline verification on each answer/navigation/finish command at atomic commit

gaps.issue: Result unlock must be coupled to verified durable finish, even on timer expiry
gaps.mitigation: Atomic finish receipt, retry idempotence, no premature key reveal

gaps.issue: Voice recording stops on navigation/reload and raw audio is ephemeral
gaps.mitigation: Persist consented audio or show no evidence and leave speaking UNGRADED

gaps.issue: Official 2027 times/replay/nav/breaks and item order unknown
gaps.mitigation: Fail-closed exact profile, transparent user practice defaults

gaps.issue: HTML audio controls can seek/replay independent of future live rules
gaps.mitigation: Clearly practice-only, verified playback policy before strict mode

gaps.issue: Typing IME/debounce/async IndexedDB can race expiration
gaps.mitigation: Define deadline cutoff and event ordering; boundary E2E

gaps.issue: Visibility change, sleep, reload, DST and device time jumps distort display
gaps.mitigation: Persist high-water evidence; test lifecycle and clock anomalies

gaps.issue: No verified digital speaking prep/response or audio cue lifecycle
gaps.mitigation: Design original separately sourced phase machine; preserve UNKNOWN

gaps.issue: Offline client is not secure proctor clock
gaps.mitigation: Do not claim exam-grade proctoring or authenticated time

decision_rules: No official duration value until first-party confirmation

No audio file means speaking UNGRADED
